name: s6_random_points
title: At random read points Oracle Lens never states 'inside a string', yet its words carry the state
caption: Random read points in random public documents, nothing prompted, one readout per reader. Left: share of readouts a blind judge (readout only) says state the position is inside a string literal, exps 27 + 23 pooled, every in-string point and matched negatives; Wilson 95%; unparsed verdicts dropped. Right: in-string vs not on the Python + JavaScript points, AUROC of a probe on the layer-42 activation and of a bag-of-tokens classifier on each reader's readout text alone; grouped 5-fold by source file, cluster-bootstrap 95% over files. Caveat: by the strict regex the NLA names the string state on only 0.02 of in-string readouts and Oracle Lens on none; the judge's 0.22 (states) counts the NLA's own wording ('mid-quotation').
